title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #588: Collinear Points in Planar Configurations. Status: OPEN

title: F
content: f_k(n): the maximum number of lines containing at least k points, minimized over all configurations of n points with no k+1 collinear.

title: Sylvester K3
content: **Sylvester's Theorem**: f₃(n) = n²/6 + O(n).  For configurations with no 4 collinear points, the number of lines through at least 3 points is approximately n²/6. ∃ C : ℝ, C > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 3 → |(f 3 n : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)^2 / 6| ≤ C * n

title: Lower Bound K4
content: **Known lower bound**: f_k(n) ≫ n^{2 - c/√(log n)} for some constant c > 0. This is close to n² but not quite o(n²). ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 3 → (f 4 n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ (2 - c / Real.sqrt (Real.log n))

title: Erdos Conjecture K4
content: **Erdős's Conjecture (OPEN)**: f_k(n) = o(n²) for k ≥ 4.  That is, requiring at most k collinear points (k ≥ 4) should force the number of k-rich lines to be strictly subquadratic. ∀ k : ℕ, k ≥ 4 → ∀ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ N₀ → (f k n : ℝ) ≤ ε * (n : ℝ)^2

title: Erdos 588
content: The k = 3 case is resolved (Sylvester). The k ≥ 4 case remains open: is f_k(n) = o(n²)? ∃ C : ℝ, C > 0 ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 3 → |(f 3 n : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)^2 / 6| ≤ C * n := sylvester_k3
